$comment: Compounds used in creative work, with the facts a generator needs: which spectrum category owns them, the cap and cake colors that must be pinned in a prompt, and the canonical asset for each. This is a CREATIVE subset, not the commercial catalog — the full catalog authority is Brand Context/NuLumin_BioSciences.md.

catalogFacts.$comment: Counts resolved 2026-07-29 against nulumin.org/products, which serves exactly 66 SKU codes across 31 product tokens. 31 counts PRODUCTS; 66 counts dose-level SKUs. The 36 on the Q2 2026 wholesale PDF cover is that sell sheet's SKU line-item count (spanning only 23 products) mislabelled as compounds — see ASSETS.md.
catalogFacts.phrasing: Always cite "31 research peptides" — never 32, never 36.

capColors.$comment: Caps render as bare aluminium by default. Pin the color explicitly in every prompt or it comes back silver.
capColors.violet: a glossy injection-moulded flip-top in saturated brand VIOLET (#7C6FF7-#9B8FE8). The cap is clearly, unmistakably PURPLE — never bare silver, never grey, never colourless
capColors.cyan: a glossy injection-moulded flip-top in bright light CYAN-BLUE (#3FBEDD-#7ADCF0). The cap is clearly, unmistakably BLUE — never bare silver, never grey, never colourless

cakeColors.$comment: The lyophilized cake. Default renders come back white; GHK-Cu is the one that must be corrected every time.
cakeColors.offWhite: a SOLID MATTE OFF-WHITE lyophilized cake — one intact pressed disc with a perfectly FLAT LEVEL top, never a heap of loose powder
cakeColors.copperViolet: a BLUISH-VIOLET lyophilized cake — the characteristic colour of a copper peptide

glassColors.$comment: The vial body itself. Renders default to clear, so amber must be pinned explicitly in the prompt or NAD+ comes back in clear glass — which is what happened to the packshot set before 2026-07-29.
glassColors.amber: AMBER light-protective pharmaceutical glass — a warm translucent golden-brown tint carried through the whole glass body, deepening where the glass is thickest at the shoulder and base. Real tinted glass: still translucent, still refractive, still carrying its bright specular highlight. Never opaque, never painted, never a sleeve or shrink band around clear glass. The cap, crimp collar and white label are NOT tinted

ghkcu.name: GHK-Cu
ghkcu.notes: Leads the demand ranking and is the only compound with a genuinely advertisable lane — FDA restored "GHK-Cu, except injectable routes" to Category 1 on 2026-05-14. Default hero for a single-compound creative.

nad.name: NAD+
nad.notes: NAD+ ships in AMBER light-protective glass, not clear — pin `glass` in every prompt or it renders clear.

tesamorelin.name: Tesamorelin
tesamorelin.notes: Unexploited in market demand terms — a deliberate split-test opportunity. No dedicated cutout asset yet; generate a hero first.

glp3.name: GLP-3
glp3.riskFlag: HIGHEST-RISK SKU in the catalog. FDA's 2026-04-07 warning letters cited exactly this GLP-n naming pattern as an implied reference to an approved drug. Do not build a paid creative around it without explicit legal sign-off.

panels.$comment: Multi-compound creatives. Never called a "stack" — see AD_SYSTEM.md.

demandRanking.$comment: Ordering used to choose which compound gets a creative. From project_nulumin_ad_campaign.
demandRanking.reason: PT-141 and Melanotan are dropped from ad rotation on platform-risk grounds, not demand.
